competences.description: Attacks the enemy with a bomb 3 times. The last hit installs a bomb that detonates after 2 turns with a 25% chance.

effets.description: When remaining turns reach 0, the bomb explodes to deal damage that ignores Defense and stuns for 1 turn. The damage is affected by the caster's Attack Power, and the chance of stunning is affected by the caster's Accuracy and the target's Resistance.

competences.description: Attacks all enemies 3 times with a loud bomb. Each hit inflicts Continuous Damage for 2 turns with a 35% chance. Decreases the cooldown of [Multi-Firecracker] by 1 turn whenever you inflict Continuous Damage.

effets.description: The target's HP will be damaged by 5% of the MAX HP whenever the target's turn returns. (Ignores Defense)
Reduces cool down counter of skills by 1 or more
effets.note: 1 turn per Continuous Dmg effect applied
